title: Sparkly envelope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="envGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe9b0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f0b84a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="flapGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff6d8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffd878"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- envelope body -->
  <rect x="18" y="34" width="64" height="42" rx="4" fill="url(#envGrad)" stroke="#e09a2e" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- open flap (triangle pointing down) -->
  <path d="M20 38 L50 64 L80 38 Z" fill="url(#flapGrad)" stroke="#e8a840" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- inner flap shadow line -->
  <path d="M20 38 L50 64 L80 38" fill="none" stroke="#d68e22" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- addressed heart on the front, below flap tip -->
  <path d="M50 78 C46 73 40 73 40 78 C40 83 50 88 50 88 C50 88 60 83 60 78 C60 73 54 73 50 78 Z" fill="#e8546a" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#b6f0ff">
    <path d="M12 16 L14 22 L20 24 L14 26 L12 32 L10 26 L4 24 L10 22 Z"/>
    <path d="M86 20 L88 26 L94 28 L88 30 L86 36 L84 30 L78 28 L84 26 Z" transform="scale(0.9) translate(9,-1)"/>
    <path d="M42 10 L44 15 L49 17 L44 19 L42 24 L40 19 L35 17 L40 15 Z" transform="scale(0.8) translate(9,2)"/>
    <path d="M74 60 L76 65 L81 67 L76 69 L74 74 L72 69 L67 67 L72 65 Z" transform="scale(1.1) translate(-5,-3)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- small dot sparkles in warmer tone -->
  <g fill="#ffe27a">
    <circle cx="20" cy="56" r="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="80" cy="52" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="86" r="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="30" cy="88" r="2"/>
  </g>
</svg>
